name: BVQA
description: BVQA is a large-scale Bengali Visual Question Answering dataset designed to facilitate research on VQA in low-resource languages. It contains around 17,800 diverse open-ended QA pairs generated from human-annotated captions of approximately 3,500 images, supporting evaluation of multimodal understanding in Bengali.
reputation: A newer low-resource multimodal benchmark with growing interest in Bengali VQA, but still limited community-wide adoption compared with major English VQA datasets.
notes: Focuses on Bengali language VQA; dataset generated using LLM in-context learning; includes open-ended QA pairs.
